messages:
emma (Eng PM): Heads-up: planning a short pre-cut sync for the upcoming release cut. Proposing Tue 10:00 PT for a 20-min rollcall + checklist review. agenda below — pls RSVP and flag blockers.
emma (Eng PM): Agenda (draft):
```
- rollcall & stakeholder confirmations (5m)
- canary plan & metrics to watch (5m)
- final infra readiness + DB migrations (5m)
- rollback criteria & post-cut ops (5m)
```

emma (Eng PM): Attendees: eng leads, release mgr, SRE, product, oncall SRE, security if available. Add names you need invited.

raj (ENG Lead): I can make 10:00. Please add @maria (frontend) and @kevin (api) — they have last-minute reviews.

alice (SRE): 10:00 works. I'll bring the health-check playbook and the migration runbook. will post link in thread. :white_check_mark:

tom (Release Manager): Tom here — will drive the go/no-go. Quick ask: can we move DB migration to +10m into the window? need a small maintenance slot that overlaps with traffic ramp. If not, I'll re-run schedule.
sasha (Product): I have a calendar conflict at 10:00-10:20 PT. Can we do 10:30? If not, i'll join for the first 5 and then send a delegate.

emma (Eng PM): @sasha noted. Preference poll: 10:00 still preferred by eng leads. If Sasha can't be there, please delegate. I'll capture decisions in the doc.

deploy-bot: build/17845 passed integration tests on main — canary image available at gcr.redwood/infra/release-17845:canary. (smoke=ok, latency=3.2ms p50).

raj (ENG Lead): Ping @kevin @maria to confirm reviews are green before cut. If any CRs are open by EOD Mon, call it out here.

alice (SRE): I'll run the pre-cut chaos smoke at T-30m and post results in #incidents. If anything >5% error, we hold.

tom (Release Manager): Noted. Final checklist I'll circulate 30m before. Action items for meeting: 1) leads confirm CRs + hotfixes, 2) SRE verifies canary metrics, 3) product confirms feature flags.

sasha (Product): I'll delegate to Maya for the 10:00 slot — she'll confirm flags and acceptance criteria.

emma (Eng PM): Great. RSVP tally so far: raj, alice, tom, maya (delegated), emma. If you haven't replied, please react :thumbsup: or :wave:. I'll update the calendar invite to include the extra attendees and attach the checklist doc.

raj (ENG Lead): quick note — include the A/B traffic split config (we're doing 5% canary). also add rollback command snippet in agenda: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api --to-revision=17844`

emma (Eng PM): added rollback snippet. I'll post final agenda + invite at 17:00 PT today. Thanks everyone.
